listing.name: SF-Ship-ED
listing.summary: A familiar editor with a few new tricks & a new way to preview and edit the sector
listing.aiSummary: Edits ships, weapons, and variants with features like multipart vessel mode, screenshot mode, and damage mode.

description:
A familiar editor with a few new tricks & a new way to preview and edit the sector

Both editors run under Windows, Wine/Linux and the native Linux version. Sf Sector Ed has native linux and windows versions.

SF-Ship-ED
The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers

Some of the bigger added features:

-Station/Multipart Vessel Mode
-Screenshot Mode
-Multi Mod de/activatior
-Linux installation Path support
-Damage Mode
-browse loaded mod files in most modes

aiDescription: Provides tools for editing ship hulls, variants, projectiles, and raw JSON files. Includes a CSV editor revamp, drag-and-drop functionality, and support for Linux installation paths.
